question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

The __**current**__ debate involves key economic issues.

options.text: The swimmer fought against the current.
The minister spoke on current policy.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "The swimmer fought against the current."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"current"** in the highlighted sentence refers to something happening or existing at the present time. (वर्तमान)

 
 
• **Example:** The current debate involves key economic issues.
 
 
 
• The correct word **"current"** as used in Option 1 refers to the flow of water, electricity, or air in a particular direction. (धारा)
 
 
• **Example:** The swimmer struggled to swim against the strong river current.
 
 
 
• Since "current" in Option 1 represents a homonym (same spelling but different meaning) of the highlighted word, Option 1 is the correct choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: "The current trends favor decentralization."** (वर्तमान) - Refers to something happening in the present time.

 
 
• **Example:** The current trends in technology emphasize sustainability.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "His current address is unknown."** (वर्तमान) - Refers to the present or latest address.
 
 
• **Example:** Please provide us with your current address for correspondence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "The minister spoke on current policy."** (वर्तमान) - Refers to the existing or ongoing policy.
 
 
• **Example:** The minister emphasized the benefits of the current education policy.
